Subject: FintechCo discovery + next steps

Hi Lena / Tim —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned.

Summary of discovery:
- Use case: customer support automation for payments disputes; 95% of cadence is text-based triage, occasional attachments.
- Volume: ~300k monthly conversations, peak bursts during billing cycles.
- Latency requirement: <250ms median for triage responses, some async workflows can tolerate higher latency.
- Data posture: sensitive PII in some messages; they need SOC 2 + KMS and VPC/private deployment options for prod.

What Redwood proposed (high level):
- Start with hosted Redwood API for dev/proof-of-concept (alpha) to validate prompt sets and latency.
- Move to Dedicated reserved pools for production with private-network option and KMS integration.
- Suggested model: rwd-14b-quant (balance cost/quality) + prefix caching for ticket histories.

Next steps (proposed owner + ETA):
1) Redwood to share a short deck + SOC 2 summary — Marissa (today) — attached.
2) FintechCo to confirm high-priority workflows + who will own procurement/security steps — Lena — by end of week.
3) Schedule a technical session (SE deep-dive) for any red flags (E2E demo, perf constraints) — propose week of Feb 22 — Marissa/Ethan to lead.

Attachments: redwood_discovery-deck.pdf, redwood-soc2-evidence-summary.pdf (SOC 2 artifact summary).

If that sounds good I can send a calendar invite for the SE deep-dive — proposed 60 minutes, include your platform/security folks.

Thanks —
Marissa
